name: Get sandbox ID from signed preview URL token
description: Get sandbox ID from signed preview URL token GET /preview/{signedPreviewToken}/{port}/sandbox-id
context:
GET /preview/{signedPreviewToken}/{port}/sandbox-id
Get sandbox ID from signed preview URL token
Required: signedPreviewToken (path) — Signed preview URL token; port (path) — Port number to get sandbox ID from signed preview URL token

name: Get the signing key for a sandbox
description: Get the signing key for a sandbox GET /preview/{sandboxId}/signing-key
context:
GET /preview/{sandboxId}/signing-key
Get the signing key for a sandbox
Required: sandboxId (path) — ID of the sandbox

name: Check if user has access to the sandbox
description: Check if user has access to the sandbox GET /preview/{sandboxId}/access
context:
GET /preview/{sandboxId}/access
Check if user has access to the sandbox
Required: sandboxId (path)

name: Check if the preview warning page is enabled for the sandbox
description: Check if the preview warning page is enabled for the sandbox GET /preview/{sandboxId}/preview-warning
context:
GET /preview/{sandboxId}/preview-warning
Check if the preview warning page is enabled for the sandbox
Required: sandboxId (path) — ID of the sandbox, or a signed preview URL token (requires the port query param)
Optional: port (query) — Port the signed preview URL token was issued for. Required when sandboxId is a signed token.
